frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard IV.B REQUIRES written consent of all parties before accepting compensation that could compete with the employer's interest; IV.C imposes affirmative detect/prevent/document obligations on supervisors and reaches supervisors who fail to escalate inadequate compliance systems even absent direct knowledge of subordinate violations.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard IV(B) Additional Compensation Arrangements + IV(C) Responsibilities of Supervisors
